checks.message: Total 192.8 min is within the usable 252.0 min (360 min minus a 30% reserve).
At its worst, at 2850 m along the route, elapsed time plus the way back to the start is 192.8 min, within the 360 min limit.
Dose 85.7 uSv is within the limit of 1000 uSv.

solar_event.note: Whole-event absorbed dose if unprotected. In Gy; not added to radiation_dose_usv.

walking.v_flat_kmh.source: NASA Apollo planning value for walkbacks over 1 hour

walking.tobler_k.source: Tobler hiking function (1993), fitted to unsuited walkers on Earth; used for the slope shape only

walking.tobler_offset.source: Tobler hiking function (1993); cancels after normalising to 1 on flat ground

walking.gravity_m_s2.source: NASA Mars Fact Sheet (NSSDC), surface gravity

walking.leg_length_m.source: Team choice: typical adult leg length

walking.froude_walk_run.source: Walk-run transition at Froude number 0.5, Kram et al. 1997 (reduced-gravity locomotion)

constraints.slope_max_deg.source: Same as the red slope threshold in terrain/thresholds.toml (a starting value there)

constraints.cliff_buffer_m.source: Team choice: ring around over-limit slopes. Has no effect when below cell_m (the nearest neighbour is already one cell away); 0 turns it off

risk.yellow_rate.source: Team choice: a minute on yellow counts double at w = 1

risk.steep_onset_deg.source: Same as the yellow slope threshold in terrain/thresholds.toml

risk.steep_rate_max.source: disabled: yellow already encodes 10–20° slope; re-enable if Nahla changes yellow

risk.near_red_radius_m.source: Team choice: three cells at 5 m

risk.near_red_rate_max.source: Team choice: rate at distance 0 from a red cell, falling linearly to 0 at near_red_radius_m

profiles.w_fastest.source: Definition of the fastest profile: risk is ignored

profiles.sweep_w.source: Team choice: spans fastest to beyond safest

sensitivity.v_flat_kmh.source: 2.7: Apollo walkback planning value. 3.4: energy-optimal walking speed in Mars gravity, Cavagna et al. 1998

sensitivity.slope_max_deg.source: Team choice: 5 degrees either side of the limit

timeline.stop_order.source: Default until Zakiyyah decides whether routing may reorder stops

timeline.optimise_max_stops.source: Team choice: 8 stops is 40,320 orders, still fast; above this, optimise falls back to as_listed with a warning

timeline.stop_min_default.source: STOP_MIN in data/make_fake.py; to be replaced by the mission brief

timeline.ingress_min.source: Team choice, confirmed by Tushaar: time to get back inside at the start

timeline.eva_max_min.source: CONTRACT.md plan.json example; to be replaced by the mission brief

radiation.background_dose_rate_msv_day.source: Curiosity RAD (MSL) at Gale, Hassler et al. 2014; applied to Jezero

radiation.limit_usv.source: CONTRACT.md plan.json example; to be replaced by the mission brief

radiation.solar_event_dose_mgy.source: Curiosity RAD (MSL) at Gale, 20 May 2024, NASA; applied to Jezero. Stays in Gy

radiation.baseline_tolerance_pct.source: Team choice: warn when the radiation.csv median differs from the config rate by more

radiation.storm_detect_factor.source: Team choice: hours at or above this are listed as storm hours

shelter_map.colour_max_min.source: Same range as the fake layer in data/make_fake.py

track.spacing_m.source: Team choice: five cells at 5 m, enough for the slope profile

start.xy_m.source: Landing spot L1 from web/src/lib/landing.js recommendLanding (flat 50 m pad, shortest walk to the first and last stop), computed on data/out of 2026-11-14; temporary until the full Jezero dataset is loaded

reach.crop_m.unit: "full" or [x0, y0, x1, y1] in m on the site grid
reach.crop_m.source: Team choice: the whole site.grid of layers.json until the full-crater grid is decided

reach.downsample.unit: site cells per export cell (whole number)
reach.downsample.source: Team choice: 1 keeps the site resolution

reach.destination_stop.source: Team choice (Tushaar): the over-budget limit counts one stop of timeline.stop_min_default at the destination; false sets it to 0

warnings: waypoints.geojson: waypoint 'rover' uses kind 'rover', which is deprecated; it is read as 'start'. Please change it to 'start'.
waypoints.geojson puts its start waypoint at (1000, 900) m, more than half a cell from start.xy_m (1387.5, 712.5) m in routing/config.toml; the config value is used
